main_text.p: Καὶ τί οἱ φίλτρον.) Caufa media τῆς ἐπιμέλης: oftendit autem nil fe omiffurum, quò Chironem Hieroni adduceret: φίλ-τρον enim plerunque pro efficaci amatoria potione vfur-patur. ait Euftat. effe λαχανὸν τι διεγερτικὸν εἰς ἀφροδίσια. hinc ἀντεγερτικὰ τῆς νόσου ἢ φιλίας pharmaca dicuntur φίλθρα.
Ἰατρῷ τοι κεν μιν.) Caufa finalis philtri, vt bonis viris ægrotantibus fuccurreret. ἐσλῶν pro ἐσθλῶν per clifionem τῶ,ϑ.
Θερμὸν νόσων.) Speciem morbi videtur exprimere calidum fuiffe morbum: vnde putant Hieronem febri laborafle: alij pedum dolore, vt eft podagra: aut λιϑουρία.

Ἠ πνα Λατοΐδα.) Μητρφνμικὸν eft Apollinis a matre Latone, intelligit Aefculapium: aut patris Iouis, hoc eft Apollinem. Complexione ergo breuiori ita colligit: fi mihi effet optandi poteftas, optarim mihi adeffe Chironem, aut Aefculapium, vel ipfum Apollinem. atque haftenus prior hypotheticæ propofitionis pars.

Καὶ κεν ἐν νᾶῳ.) Altera propofitionis pars: deducere eum in Siciliam ad Hieronem: viam autem breuiter defcribit, per Ionium mare: dicitur Ionium mare, Adriaticum pelagus iuxta Siciliam, à Ionio Illyrico viro: vel vt Arehidami eft fententia ab Ioniis ibi pereuntibus: alij ὑπὸ ἰοῖς dictum volunt. vide fcholia Græca. Arethufa fons eft in Ortygia Siciliæ, de quo fabulantur, quòd Alphæum fluuium amat: alius eiufdem nominis fons in Ithaca, item in Chalcide & Smyrna fons eft Arethufa. Et inter Melias nymphas eft Arethufa etiam in commentariis Zetzis in Hefiodum.
Παρ Αἰτναῖον ξένον.) Hic abfoluitur propofitio, Aetneum hofpitem dicit Hieronē, quòd fe Aetnæum nominarit & proclamari voluerit in victoriis.

main_text.p: Breuiter laudat Hieronem, & quanta cum gloria tanto comitatus medico Pindarus foret excipiendus ab Hierone.

page.notes: Greek lemmas and scholia are transcribed from a small, low-contrast scan; the accents and breathings in the lemmas (e.g. Καὶ τί οἱ φίλτρον, ἐπιμέλου, Ἰατρῷ τοι κεν μιν, Ἠ πνα Λατοΐδα, Καὶ κεν ἐν νᾶῳ, Παρ Αἰτναῖον, Ὡς Συρακόσιαι) are doubtful and should be checked against the page image. The Greek in the commentary line "Μητρφνμικὸν" and "ὑπὸ ἰοῖς" and the word "λιϑουρία" are particularly uncertain. The drop cap B was joined to "reuiter" to form "Breuiter". The Strophe heading was set as a level 3 head. The Greek word "ἐσλῶν" and "ἐσθλῶν" are uncertain. The second paragraph's Latin "philtri" and "φίλθρα" are printed as seen.
